subject: Outdoor Dining Ordinance Updates
overview: The committee reviewed and amended a proposed ordinance for seasonal outdoor dining, focusing on fee tiers, liability coverage, and safety standards. The paper was reported out favorably as amended.

items.title: Ordinance Overview and Fee Structure
items.summary: Yvette Niwa presented updates to Paper 22-514, which establishes a statement of intent and a tiered fee system based on whether seating is on the sidewalk or in street-level parklets.

items.title: Alcohol Service Requirements
items.summary: Staff clarified that restaurants must obtain an alteration of premises license to serve alcohol in temporary outdoor dining areas.

items.title: Insurance and Indemnification
items.summary: Approved a motion to update insurance requirements and indemnity clauses to ensure the city is held harmless for incidents in the public way.

items.title: Safety Barriers and Design Standards
items.summary: The committee discussed the use of concrete versus water-filled barriers and reviewed height limits and lighting restrictions intended to maintain traffic safety and visibility.

items.title: Patio Heater Amendment
items.summary: Approved an amendment to include language requiring outdoor patio heaters to comply with the state fire code.

items.title: Disposition of Paper 22-514
items.summary: Approved reporting the ordinance out to the City Council favorably as amended.
